subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should these two MCP entry points guarantee one shared synthetic fatal-diagnostic format across their separate ownership surfaces?
rationale: Code similarity does not establish whether identical serialized output is intentional product behavior, and choosing a shared core helper would create an ownership and compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep diagnostics owner-local
options.body: Allow each entry point to format its own fatal diagnostics unless a concrete shared consumer or protocol contract is identified.

options.title: Define a shared envelope
options.body: Approve a stable generic diagnostic contract, place its formatter at a neutral documented seam, and test both pipelines against it.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics owner-local
recommendation.body: Allow each entry point to format its own fatal diagnostics unless a concrete shared consumer or protocol contract is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: The Codex harness refactor provides the strongest available history for deciding the intended core-versus-extension boundary.
